en.description:
Experience the thrill of a classic arcade claw machine right on your Apple Watch! This carefully crafted casual game brings a whole new entertainment experience to your wrist. Relive the joyful moments of childhood arcade halls and start your claw machine adventure anytime, anywhere!

Game Features:
• Intuitive Controls - Use the Digital Crown for precise claw control, tap to grab, smooth and natural operation
• Diverse Rewards - Various cute dolls, mystery boxes, coins, shining diamonds, rare pets, and many more surprises
• Level Progression - Carefully designed levels with gradual difficulty increase, unlock special items as you advance
• Skill & Luck Combined - Test your timing and strategy, each item has unique catch rates
• Achievement System - Track your high scores, challenge yourself, break records
• Fun Mechanics - Consecutive failed attempts increase success rate, keeping hope alive with every try
• Perfect for Watch - Optimized for Apple Watch, smooth performance, battery efficient

Game Highlights:
• Fresh and cute visuals
• Relaxing casual gameplay
• Unique wearable gaming experience
• No in-app purchases, pure gaming fun
• Compatible with all Apple Watch models

Challenge yourself, collect adorable prizes, and become the Claw Master! Whether you're waiting for the bus, taking a break between classes, or enjoying some downtime, this game brings unexpected joy to your day!

zh.trackName: 掌上抓娃娃 - 手表游戏
zh.description:
在您的手腕上体验街机抓娃娃的无限乐趣！这款专为 Apple Watch 精心设计的休闲游戏将带给您全新的掌上娱乐体验。感受童年街机厅的欢乐时光，随时随地开启抓娃娃冒险！

游戏特色：
• 简单直观的操作 - 使用数字表冠精确控制机械爪，轻点屏幕完成抓取，操作流畅自然
• 丰富多样的奖品 - 多款可爱娃娃、神秘宝箱、金币、闪耀钻石、稀有宠物等众多惊喜
• 关卡进阶系统 -  精心设计的关卡，难度循序渐进，随着等级提升解锁更多特殊物品
• 技巧与运气并存 - 考验您的抓取时机和策略，每个物品都有独特的抓取概率
• 成就系统 - 记录您的最高分，挑战自我，突破记录
• 趣味玩法 - 连续抓取失败会提高成功率，让每次尝试都充满希望
• 完美适配手表 - 针对 Apple Watch 优化设计，流畅运行，节省电量

游戏特点：
- 清新可爱的游戏画面
- 轻松休闲的游戏节奏
- 独特的手表体验设计
- 无需内购，纯粹的游戏乐趣
- 支持所有 Apple Watch 机型

挑战自我，收集各种可爱娃娃，成为抓娃娃大师！无论是等待公交、课间休息，还是茶余饭后，都能带给您意想不到的欢乐！
